observations: Photos show a bare automotive engine block out of the vehicle, placed on a wooden pallet in what looks like a parts yard or workshop.
A handwritten tag 'K2' is taped to the top of the engine and another handwritten '012' tag is on the timing cover.
Timing belt/chain area, pulleys, tensioner, wiring harness connectors and coil packs are visible, consistent with a 4-cylinder engine.
No manufacturer engine code (e.g. a stamped code like 2AR-FE, 1NZ-FE etc.) is legible in any photo.
A watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' overlays the images, seller's shop branding.
Hoses and harness look used/aged with some loose clips and a disconnected-looking bracket near a hose clamp in photo 1.
No compression test, running video, VIN plate, or odometer/mileage reference is shown.
No full engine view (front, back, oil pan, exhaust manifold side) is given, only partial close-ups of the timing belt side and valve cover side.
